adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 147 in the diff, the code finds the selectedCalendar by matching `cal.credentialId === credentialId`. If a destination calendar was created before this refactor and doesn't have a credentialId set, the find() will return undefined, and the code falls back to 'primary' calendar. This is a real bug where legacy destination calendars without credentialId will not be matched, causing events to be created on the primary calendar instead of the configured destination.
